name: What preparation is needed before interior painters start working?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before interior painters start working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before interior painters begin, you should ideally clear the room of small items, wall hangings, and breakables. Furniture should be moved to the center of the room or to another area, if possible, to allow for easier access. While contractors will protect your floors and remaining furniture with drop cloths and plastic, having the space as clear as possible helps expedite the preparation phase and ensures a smoother painting process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prior to painting, clear small items, wall hangings, and move furniture away from walls. This helps expedite preparation.
